allowed: Run the existing calibration engine on the explicitly recorded target.
Evaluate the independent paper-level holdout without an acceptance claim.
Report transfer assumptions, assay mismatch, and numerical error.
not_allowed: Treat a computational match as biological validation.
Call the selected condition a Parkinson disease stage or mechanism.
Use the result for diagnosis, clinical prediction, treatment evidence, or drug response.
Promote reference-only literature values to calibration targets without review.

required_follow_up: Research lead verifies both source locations, statistics, units, genotype, age, sex, and assay context.
Research lead decides whether the transfer assumptions are acceptable for the stated computational question.
Add independently reviewed targets for metrics other than mean_planar_speed_mm_s before multi-metric calibration.
Keep holdout interpretation descriptive until a pre-registered acceptance rule exists.
